en.headline: Hong Kong Observatory cancels Red Fire Danger Warning
en.dek: The Observatory lifted the Red Fire Danger Warning late on Wednesday after it had been in force since early Monday, with the fire risk no longer extreme.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Red Fire Danger Warning at 11pm on Wednesday, the agency said in its warning bulletin.
The warning had been issued at 6:10am on Monday, when the Observatory assessed the fire risk as extreme due to dry conditions under a northeast monsoon.
With the warning now lifted, the extreme fire danger level no longer applies. Residents are still advised to remain cautious with open flames and flammable materials during the dry season.
No other weather warnings were in force after the cancellation, according to the Observatory's latest update.

zh.headline: 天文台取消紅色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台周三深夜取消自周一起生效的紅色火災危險警告，火災危險性已不再處於極高程度。
body: 香港天文台表示，紅色火災危險警告已於周三晚上11時取消。
該警告於周一早上6時10分發出，當時天文台評估在東北季候風影響下，火災危險性極高。
警告取消後，極高火災危險程度不再適用。市民在乾燥季節仍應小心使用明火及易燃物品。
根據天文台最新資訊，取消後目前沒有其他天氣警告生效。
